# Ontology Builder — Capability Mapping

How the extracted VocBench 3, WebProtégé and Protégé Desktop features map onto the **Ontology Engineering Capability Model** (`ontology_engineering_capabilities/`), and therefore onto the **EKGF EKG Maturity Model** levels the platform is being built to reach.

**Coverage:** 42 of 44 capabilities are realised by at least one Ontology Builder feature.

## 1. Coverage by EKGF maturity level

| Level | Capabilities | Realised | Features | Phases involved |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **L1 EKG Initiation** | 5 | 5 | 15 | P0, P2, P3, P4, P5, P6, P7 |
| **L2 Extensible Platform** | 14 | 13 | 91 | P0, P1, P2, P3, P4, P5, P6, P7, P8 |
| **L3 Enterprise Ready** | 15 | 15 | 93 | P0, P1, P2, P3, P4, P5, P6, P7, P8 |
| **L4 Strategic Asset** | 7 | 6 | 47 | P0, P1, P2, P3, P4, P5, P6, P7, P8 |
| **L5 Operational Ecosystem** | 3 | 3 | 21 | P0, P2, P3, P4, P6, P7, P8 |

The Level-2 (*Extensible Platform*) target of the existing application architecture (`architecture/ARCHITECTURE.md`) is met in full by phases **P0–P4**. Phases **P5–P8** carry the platform into L3–L5.

## 3. Capabilities deliberately out of scope

These are realised by enterprise systems the Ontology Builder should integrate with, not replace — consistent with `architecture/ARCHITECTURE.md`, which already assigns them to COTS components (`C.FUND` Portfolio & Funding Management, `C.SKILL` Skills & Talent Management).

| Capability | Target level | Realised instead by |
|---|---|---|
| **B.SG.4** Funding & Investment Management | L2 | Portfolio/PPM tooling; the Builder contributes project inventory and effort signals via `OB.PRJ.06` / `OB.PRJ.10`. |
| **B.VP.1** Value Case & Benefits Realization | L4 | Benefits-tracking in the enterprise's own value framework; the Builder contributes usage and quality KPIs (`OB.PRJ.10`, `OB.QLT.04`). |
